βαβαί , exclam. of surprise or amazement,
A.bless me!
E. Cyc. 156 , Ar. Av. 272 , etc.; doubled, hurrah!
Achae. 28 , cf. Chrysipp.Stoic. 3.178 ; οὐχὶ τῶν μετρίων, ἀλλὰ τῶν βαβαὶ βαβαί, to denote persons extravagant in their expressions, Alex. 206 : c. gen., βαβαὶ τοῦ λόγου bless me what an argument! Pl. Phlb. 23b , cf. Jul. Caes. 309b , etc. (On the accent, cf. Hdn.Gr. 1.502 ; βαβαῖ cod. B in Pl. l.c.)
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
